dedupe_keys.name: togo national flood susceptibility index fsi and flood risk index fri geotiff susceptibility raster and fri geopackages for cantons 1 km and 500 m grids 2026

description: The Togolese ministry in charge of digital transformation published in June 2026 a national flood hazard and risk model on opendata.gouv.tg. Contents: a Flood Susceptibility Index raster built with the frequency ratio method from a flood inventory of 2016 to 2023 and terrain (elevation, slope, aspect, TPI, TRI, TWI), distance to rivers and lagoons, 2023 land cover, soils and geology, with a reported ROC AUC of 92 per cent; and a Flood Risk Index combining susceptibility with exposure (population and infrastructure) and socio-economic vulnerability, aggregated to cantons and to 1 km and 500 m grids; plus PNG and PDF maps. Producer: the ministry, with processing in a Python GIS environment. Coverage: all of Togo. Format and access: a zipped GeoTIFF (79 MB) and three GeoPackages (1.2 MB, 14.5 MB, 58 MB), downloadable without registration. Licence: Open Data Commons PDDL 1.0. Caveats: this is a statistical susceptibility index, not a hydraulic model, so it gives no flood depths or return periods; the flood inventory and exposure inputs are not published with it. Simulation uses: screening flood exposure of roads, water points and other assets, prioritising cantons for adaptation, and weighting hazard in resilience studies. Related records: the Togo road inventory (data-togo-geodata-national-road-inventory-classified-roads-rural-tracks-drainage) and water points record (data-togo-geodata-drinking-water-points-water-towers-standpipes-hand-pumps) provide the assets to overlay.
